title: Just ok
text: Just ok. First off, I don’t like the gold bands. They are flimsy and look ugly. They also are just the teeniest bit smaller than a ball/Kerr lid so they only fit in this jar. Second, the glass is very thin and I’m leary about putting these in a 30 minute hot water bath. I wouldn’t prefer them again. But, they are packed very well and arrived all entact. Lots of extra lids came with these too.
